rules.statement: A tenant must pay rent to the authorized person as per section 21 of the Rent Act, and this means an actual payment that augments the funds of the authorized person. The Municipal Council cannot transmit money orders made out in favor of one person to another.
rules.supporting_quote: "A payment to the authorized person means, prima facie, an actual payment to him i.e. one which augments his funds. Section 21(3) requires him to transmit the amount of such payment to the landlord; this means prima facie that he must make a payment to the landlord and not merely transmit the document deposited by the tenant."
